name: kb_640_Normalized

schema.description: NonResourceRule holds information that describes a rule for the non-resource

nonResourceURLs.description: NonResourceURLs is a set of partial urls that a user should have access to.  *s are allowed, but only as the full, final step in the path.  "*" means all.

verbs.description: Verb is a list of kubernetes non-resource API verbs, like: get, post, put, delete, patch, head, options.  "*" means all.

description: The current non‑resource access rule permits the verbs **get**, **post**, and **delete**. It applies specifically to the endpoints **/healthz** and **/metrics/*** – the latter allowing any path under the metrics namespace.
